# Factions & Organizations

## French Government {#french-government}

The French Government is the national authority that sponsors scientific expeditions and organizes maritime voyages to investigate the fate of lost vessels.

## Papuans {#papuans}

The Papuans are an athletic, woolly-haired people of the islands who carry bows, arrows, and slings, and who have been observed gathering in large numbers on the shore near the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus).
